purpose: Crosswalk from the registered requirement taxonomies (es#191 terminal contract; RELEASING.md release gate) to the packet's claim ids, so the packet's own taxonomy can never silently substitute for the registered one (gauntlet ruling R14-taxonomy-substitution-no-register, run es-v6-candidate-freeze-2026-08-18). validate_v6_assurance.py fails on any registered requirement with neither covering claims nor an explicit disposition.

claim_classes.authority: es#191 'Terminal contract', clause 1: 'every material current public, normative, compatibility, security, behavioral, mission-custody, harness, and release claim'

evidence_classes.authority: es#191 'Terminal contract', clause 4: 'deterministic, structural, hostile-input, lifecycle, crash/recovery, migration, concurrency, performance, stability, clean-clone/archive, behavioral, native-harness, Windows, Linux, macOS, and filesystem-dependent evidence is complete to the bounded claims'

concurrency.reason: The es#173 adjudication ruled NO-GO on adopting any custody concurrency design this cycle; the reachable concurrent-open ambiguity path is named and disclosed (mission-custody SECURITY.md, 'Discovery ambiguity DISARMS the gate') rather than claimed closed. Carried as a known limit, owner: mission-custody contract (es#173).

performance.reason: v6.0 makes no performance claim. The package is documentation plus stdlib checking scripts; the only recorded measurements (custody scope_consistency scaling table in SECURITY.md) exist to justify a design refusal, not to claim a performance property.

RG-1-candidate-identity-and-scope.note: Exact-candidate identity is carried by the packet's candidate_sha plus the per-file digests and tree hash in source-inventory (R5).

RG-2-release-decisions-and-risk-acceptan.reason: Operator decisions are recorded in docs/v6/operator-decision-record-2026-08-18.md (echo-certified) and acceptance follows docs/v6/OPERATOR-ACCEPTANCE-PROCEDURE.md; risk acceptance is the operator-acceptance act itself, not a packet claim.

RG-3-evidence-retention.note: evidence_paths in the packet plus docs/v6/evidence/ and the committed gauntlet run directory are the retained record.

RG-9-publication-identity-plan.reason: The BUILD packet publishes nothing; publication identity (tag, Release, wiki) is verified inside the separate PROMOTION_RUN per RELEASING.md steps 7-10 and the two-stage boundary es#191 approved.

notes: Claim ids referenced here that the matrix does not yet carry (CLM-COMPATIBILITY, CLM-SECRET-SCAN, CLM-MC-GUARD-LEXICAL, CLM-DESCRIPTION-BUDGET, CLM-DISPOSITION-CENSUS) are the R14/R2/R15/D3.5/R6 additions landing in the same candidate; validate_v6_assurance.py fails closed if any referenced claim id is absent from the matrix, so this register cannot cite claims that do not exist at freeze time.
The durable coordination program is named in es#191 itself; its coordinates are deliberately not repeated here (public-content gate, private-fleet class).
